strategic_assessment: With Hollandia absent, US fast-carrier effort remaining centered on the Marshalls/Carolines and repeated pressure on Truk/Palau raises Japanese confidence that the Central Pacific/Marianas is the next decisive axis. It is not yet exact D-Day intelligence.
actions: Disperse aircraft among multiple strips/revetments rather than create one easily countable concentration.
Increase radar/plot/communications redundancy and pre-wire alternate command posts.
Build ammunition/fuel dispersal and rapid runway-repair stores.
Use flying boats/recon/seaplanes for outer warning; do not consume all long-range aircraft on routine offensive sweeps.
Continue 9th Tank Regiment integration and ground-air liaison without launching an unnecessary island counteroffensive.
guard: Do not jump directly to the June pre-invasion OOB. May reinforcement, attrition, ferry loss and training remain separate clocks.
